prompt:
High-fidelity mobile web UI design comp, portrait phone viewport, for a retreat survey app. This is a designed interface screen, not a poster: it must read as a screenshot of a working product.

Layout scaffold, top to bottom: top-left corner: tiny white uppercase tracked-out kicker "FOR THE BUILDERS OF THE ATMOSPHERE". Middle 30% is pure photograph, no text. Lower half, left-aligned stack: first a small warm intro line in light sans: "You raised your hand. It's happening." Then the stacked display words "ATMOSPHERIC" over "BUILDERS' RETREAT." in very tall ultra-condensed white grotesque capitals across most of the width. Under it, four narrow rows separated by thin white hairline rules, small caps: "3 NIGHTS · 2 FULL DAYS", "SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA", "SEPT 1 – NOV 15", and "SPONSORED BY BLUESKY — LODGING & FOOD COVERED" with a small butterfly glyph. Then a white pill button with black text "Sign in with Atmosphere". Bottom-left: tiny author line, small circular avatar, white text "organized by @bryan". Right edge: slim vertical rail of four thin white outline glyphs (heart, speech bubble, paper plane, bookmark). Bottom-center: seven small progress dots, first solid, rest faint.

Background media: one photograph fills the frame edge to edge — a mid-century desert courtyard at dusk near Palm Springs: white breeze-block wall, warm interior light spilling out, saguaro-like cacti and palms, dramatic pink-orange sky over mountains. Soft dark scrim gradient rises from the bottom half. Subtle film grain. Every interface element pure white; no other UI color. No status bar, no browser chrome. Flat matte, no gloss.
